notes.title: Anomalistic Revolution Demo Update: New Character Designs & Improvements
notes.notes:
We've made some exciting changes!

Character Designs: We've revamped the character designs for Saye, Elis, and Roza in the dialogue boxes. They now look sharper and more aligned with their personalities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157122/e9c7f4e03b0b685ab773545f7684f5a1da902e1b.png[/img]

Gameplay & Story Tweaks: We've made small but impactful changes to gameplay and the storyline to improve the overall experience.

We're putting in a lot of effort to complete the story and finalize the game, and we appreciate your support during this journey. We're working hard to make Anomalistic Revolution the best it can be!

Make sure to follow us for more updates. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Anomalistic Revolution Demo Update: Now in Japanese!
notes.notes:
The Anomalistic Revolution demo is now available with Japanese translation!

Enjoy the game in a whole new way with full Japanese localization. It’s time to dive into the action!

We’d love to hear your feedback on the translation! Join our Discord for demo localization support, corrections, or suggestions.

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Anomalistic Revolution - Demo Update
notes.notes: The memory system now features new animations and enhanced visuals, bringing each moment to life like never before. We’ve also polished several scenes for a smoother, more immersive experience. Jump back in and see the difference!

notes.title: Major Update: Lore
notes.notes:
The world of Anomalistic Revolution is growing in new and exciting ways! With this major update, we’ve expanded the story and given the TruuCrafter interface a fresh makeover, adding more personality and style. Now, making your strategic choices feels smoother and more fun.

We’ve also updated the action animations and character designs, bringing a fresh energy to the game. And this is just the start—there’s more visual polish and animation upgrades coming your way in future updates.

We're always working to make Anomalistic Revolution better, and there’s still so much more to explore!

notes.title: Demo Update: New 2.5D Designs and Themes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have just released a major update for Anomalistic Revolution. This might be the last significant graphics update for the game. Here are the details:

We've made a big change to the action run scenes! By adding 2.5D designs and new themes, we've added depth to the scenes, creating a more immersive experience. These new designs make the characters and environments more dynamic and impressive, adding excitement to the game.

In future updates, we will further enhance the environments in Saye's deeper daytime nightmares. We'll also make small improvements to the existing action run scenes, integrating them through minor updates.

We are also working on the run action mechanics and plan to introduce more thrilling and lively combat scenes in the future with a new major update. Anomalistic Revolution and the main game are still in development. Stay tuned for more updates.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Upcoming Update: Mastering Inner Energy
notes.notes:
Upcoming Update: Mastering Inner Energy

We've got some exciting news! We're working on a big update for the Anomalistic Revolution demo.

In the game, we have something called 'Inner Potential Score.' It's like the 'mana' or 'energy' in many RPGs, measuring the character's spiritual and mental capacity. In the next update, if we use up these points, or go into the negative, there will be consequences. So, we've got to be careful with our character's inner energy.

We're also making some small updates to skills, both in number and how you get them. This means a fresh look for the choice menu and improvements to the overall design.

Lastly, there will be subtle enhancements and additions in the dialogues related to the update in the game's choice and ryo system.

Stay tuned!
